answer: Operator liability routing. Each agent identity maps to a verified operator via a signed deployment manifest stored in a public vault; identities without a live operator link are rejected by peers. Sybil clusters sharing infrastructure get grouped, and the operator is charged a graduated penalty per clustered identity from a posted reserve held in a shared river account, plus loss of routing rights. Attacker cost scales with cluster size, so N fakes cost roughly N times one, and cheap wallets do not harbor cheap operators.
